title: TMC LIVE updates: Lok Sabha Speaker invites Team Mamata before taking call on NCPI-rebel faction merger
description: TMC LIVE updates: The faction of 20 rebel MPs, which feature heavy-weights like Jadavpur MP Saayoni Ghosh, on Sunday moved to further solidify their support to the NDA by writing a letter to Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla that said the group had merged with NCPI, a party formed in 2022.
